segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I wanted to confirm the seat count and timing so I can send the final order form today. Last note I had was 48 standard seats and 6 admin seats for a May 20 go-live.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That’s right. We may add two more standard seats in June, but for the initial contract it should be 48 and 6. Finance wants the invoice to match that exactly.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, makes sense. For those 54 total users, the annual subscription comes to $38,880, and the implementation package is the one-time $4,500. So first invoice would be $43,380 plus applicable tax.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. And billing starts on May 15, not today, correct? We need a few weeks for setup and training.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct. Contract start date May 15, service term through May 14 next year. We’ll schedule kickoff the week of April 29, and our onboarding lead will handle the data import and two admin trainings.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. On contract terms, our legal team had one redline around auto-renewal notice. They asked for 60 days instead of 45.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: I saw that. Deal desk already approved the 60-day notice, so I’ll include that in the version I send. No change to pricing or term length.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Can you also make the PO number required on the invoice? It’ll be PO-4172. If it’s missing, accounts payable kicks it back.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Absolutely. I’ll add PO-4172 in the billing notes and on the order form. The invoice will go to ap@northlinecomponents.com, with you copied.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yep, that works. Send it over this afternoon and I’ll route for signature. Our VP is around tomorrow morning, so we should be able to get it done by end of day.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Great. I’ll send the clean order form and the updated terms by 2:00 Eastern. Once it’s signed, we’ll set up the kickoff invite and confirm the user list format.
